versions.content: category of IEEE1722TpIidcConnection Status: DRAFT The category of IEEE1722TpIidcConnection defines which kind of protocol shall be used for the transport of the IEEE1722TpIidcConnection • if the IEEE1722TpIidcConnection shall be transported using IIDC, then the category of the IEEE1722TpIidcConnection shall be set to IIDC • if the IEEE1722TpIidcConnection shall be transported using IEC61883, then the category of the IEEE1722TpIidcConnection shall be set to IEC61883 .
